title: O Seven May Crashes (Forty Plus Files)
style: drive folder ledger anthem, 94 bpm, deadpan filename recital rap, terminal core, recovery vibe, dry kick, sparse pad, timestamp groove, crash-export ledger flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
O seven may crashes folder on the drive
Forty plus files filed before the night arrived
Conversations dot JSON ninety six point nine MB
Users dot JSON one sixty three bytes lean and free

[Pre-Chorus]
Fifteen fifty two timestamp the export wave
Memories dot JSON thirty three KB to save

[Chorus]
O seven may crashes O seven may crashes
The folder holds the night before it lapses
Forty plus files in one Drive page
The ledger captures every stage

[Verse 2]
Crash one PNG one point three MB at four forty
Craas two PNG seven sixty nine the early
Claudes web PDF one oh oh eight KB at thirteen sixteen
Claudes web TXT three oh three KB the same scene

[Bridge]
The folder names what the night kept whole
Thirteen sixteen fifteen fifty two ten seventeen toll

[Outro]
O seven may crashes the export holds clean
Forty plus files the recovery seen
